name: What Contractors Do About HVAC and Dust Control in Mercer Island Homes
title-tag: HVAC & Dust Control During Refinishing | Mercer Island, WA
meta-description: How a refinishing crew keeps sanding dust out of your HVAC and your house: sealed vents, vacuum-assisted sanders, $250 full containment, and the honest limits.
post-summary: December 16, 2026 · Your furnace is the highway sanding dust rides to every room — so the system goes off, vents get sealed, machines capture dust at the source, and $250 buys full plastic containment. The complete protocol for Mercer Island homes, including what 'dustless' honestly doesn't mean.
